notable_absence.finding: The Query Service and Backup Service are both explicitly called out as needing 'No RAM-allocation' on this page ('Query Service: No RAM-allocation is required for this service.' / 'Backup Service: No RAM-allocation is required for this service.'), directly corroborating the already-promoted server:service-memory-quota note that Query and Backup are exempt - but this page never uses the word 'quota' for these two, it just omits the allocation field entirely. A reader who only skimmed the UI, not this text, would not necessarily infer the exemption is a stated rule rather than a UI omission.

cross_component_finding: server:arbiter-node is a genuinely new admin-only mechanism this batch's conceptual-vs-procedural hypothesis predicted might exist: no learn/ page in the registry names it, it has no data-model shape (it holds no vBuckets, runs no services), and it only exists as a side-effect of an admin choice (deselecting all services when adding/joining a node, or a dedicated 7.6+ workflow). It is created identically via two different downstream procedures - add-node-and-rebalance.md and join-cluster-and-rebalance.md - each independently stating 'if you do not select any Services, ... the node is [joins as] an arbiter node', which this record captures as createdVia relations on those two pages.
